inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Report of Criminal Complaint Against Employees: Operation failed to notify CCR after a governing body member was arrested.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report of Criminal Complaint Against Employees (26 TAC §746.305(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Child was left outside during the transition into the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: Child was denied food as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allows a person to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.      Caregiver was a floater and was present with children throughout the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Caregivers did not have visual or auditorial awareness of a child, when child was sent out of the operation surrounded by non-staff members and parent had not arrived.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The permit holder has failed to ensure compliance of the minimum standards by not creating safeguards for children during dismissal/parent pickup, after having a similar deficiency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Release of Children: Child was not released  to a parent or a person designated by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Caregiver did not have visual or auditorial awareness of a child, when child was sent out to non-staff members that were mistaken for parents of the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Operation failed to notify CCR of a non-routine situation that placed a child at risk for harm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Director did not ensure that  employees complied with the minimum standards, by having dismissal measures in place that were accordance to the minimum standards, as well as failing to report a child was left unsupervised outside with non-staff members.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The permit holder has failed to ensure compliance with the minimum standards by failing to report a child was left unsupervised outside with non-staff members after being notified by the parent of their concerns.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: Infant room had 11 infants and 2 caregiver in the classroom. The specified age of the children in the group was 0-11 months, which only allows a maximum of 10 children, two or more caregivers may supervise.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: Operation did not have a fenced in outdoor activity space in front of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: Director failed to operate in compliance of the minimum standards, by allowing caregivers to have outside time in the front of the operation's parking lot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: Operation allowed child to be present at the operation without a  completed food allergy emergency plan signed by the heath care professional and parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Operation allowed a 10 year old child to be present around infants in the 12 -18 month old classroom.     10 year old was more than 18 months older than the youngest child in the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards: Director did not ensure that  employees complied with the minimum standards in the infant room on multiple  occasions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An infant (3m) under the age of 12 months was observed with a burp cloth in the crib placed over the child's neck.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: Caregiver with a provisional eligibility which restricts them from being  alone with children,  was in violation when they were left alone in a room with 4 infants.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: Infant classroom with a  specified age 12- 18 group was out of group size. It was observed 14 children with 2 caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: The infant classroom exceeded group size. The classroom had 12 infants with 2 caregivers. Of the 12 infants,  8  were 11 months or younger. The specified age of the children in the group was 0-11 which has a maximum group size of 10 infants to 2 caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: 5 infants under the age of 12 months were observed with blankets in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allows a person to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.  Caregiver was present with children ages 3-5.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The permit holder has failed to ensure compliance with the minimum standards, as demonstrated by 9 high deficiencies and 7 medium high deficiencies within last 24  months which included several infant safe sleep deficiency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards: Director did not ensure that  employees complied with the minimum standards in the infant room on multiple  occasions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Employees Comply with Standards (26 TAC §746.1003(2))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway: A caregiver was observed with no access to a walkway without having to walk on or over the cots or mats of other children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway (26 TAC §746.2909(4))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: Operation has tunnel play structure elevated above ground that required loose-fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Covering Infant's Head or Crib: 4 infants were observed sleeping with blankets covering their heads.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Covering Infant's Head or Crib (26 TAC §746.2429)

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: The operation did not notify the parent immediately upon an infant falling off a diaper changing table approximately three to four feet to the ground and onto a hard surface.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: Permit holder failed to comply with law and minimum standards by not having a procedure in place to allow the director to have access to records when the governing body designee is not present at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child: A caregiver did not use safety straps located on the diaper changing table, bent over, and removed her hand from the infant while on the changing table. The infant fell off the table and fell approximately 3 feet to the ground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing: Operation failed to provide access to children's record during an investigation conducted by DFPS investigator.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing (26 TAC §746.601(c))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: During a DFPS investigation a caregiver was found Reason to Believe for neglect of a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
